user.title: Foyer Guests
user.description: Give guests temporary, scoped control of your home from their phone. Passes are created in the Foyer app (Settings → Guests). Guest access works on your local network only.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Foyer Guests is already set up.

data_description.lan_only: Guests can only use their pass from your home network. Requests from the internet or through Home Assistant Cloud are refused.
